name: smwpatches-baby-yoshi-grow-flag
title: Baby Yoshi Grow Flag
description:
This patch will add an address to check if baby yoshi is allowed to grow.
If set to 0 baby yoshi will grow up after eating either 5 normal items or one powerup.
If set to a non 0 value baby yoshi will never grow up.

This also kinda fixes the issue with double eating sprites.

Requested by Lazy
